Nasadenie doplnku Rewora na Shoptete: Installing the Rewora add-on on Shoptet
Doplnok nainštalujete priamo z katalógu: You install the add-on straight from the Shoptet Doplňky catalogue — without touching your template. This guide takes you from installation through activating the subscription to approving the first review.
Celé nasadenie krok za krokom — od katal: The whole rollout step by step — from the add-on catalogue to a review shown on the product page.
V administrácii Shoptetu choďte do Prepo: In the Shoptet administration go to Connections → Shoptet Doplňky.
Do vyhľadávania napíšte rewora a otvorte: Search for rewora and open the Rewora add-on.
V pravom stĺpci pri „Vaša cena“ je uvede: The right-hand column shows “Free to install” under Your price — click Order and install.
Potvrďte objednávku doplnku. Shoptet vás: Confirm the add-on order. Shoptet takes you back to the administration, where Rewora now appears among your connections.
Overenie e-mailu a otvorenie administrác: Verifying your e-mail and opening the admin
V Prepojenie → Shoptet Doplnky otvorte R: In Connections → Shoptet Doplňky open Rewora — the “Finish setting up your store” screen appears.
Overte svoju e-mailovú adresu. Potvrdzov: Verify your e-mail address. We sent the confirmation link to the store's contact e-mail.
Ak e-mail nedorazil, použite Zaslať over: If the e-mail did not arrive, use Resend verification e-mail and check your spam folder.
Po overení sa aktivuje tlačidlo Otvoriť: Once verified, the Open Rewora administration button becomes active and takes you to your account.
V administrácii Rewora otvorte sekciu Fa: In the Rewora admin open the Billing section.
Prepínačom Mesačne / Ročne zvoľte obdobi: Use the Monthly / Yearly switch to pick the period and choose a plan — Standard at €29 or Professional at €149 per month. Click Subscribe.
Platba prebieha cez Stripe: vyplňte údaj: Payment runs through Stripe: enter your card details or choose Revolut Pay and confirm Pay and subscribe. VAT is added according to your country.
Predplatné je bez rizika — ak nebudete s: The subscription is risk-free — if you are not satisfied, we refund your money within 30 days of purchase.
V sekcii Nastavenia skontrolujte názov a: In Settings check the store name and domain URL, upload your logo and, if you use it, the Business Intelligence data file.
Doplňte URL všeobecných obchodných podmi: Add the URL of your terms and conditions and the language code. If you sell in several countries, turn on automatic translation for the widgets and pick the languages.
Nastavte, kedy sa má odosielať žiadosť o: Set when the review request should be sent:
krátkodobá a dlhodobá žiadosť po doručen: a short-term and a long-term request after delivery (for example 7 and 70 days),
krátkodobá a dlhodobá žiadosť po nákupe,: a short-term and a long-term request after purchase when the delivery date is unknown (for example 21 and 90 days).
V pravom stĺpci sú vzory adries e-shopu: The right-hand column holds the URL patterns of your store (product, catalogue, cart, checkout, successful order, homepage) and the “Add to cart” button selector. With a standard Shoptet template you do not need to change them.
Ako to vyzerá na e-shope: How it looks in the store
Po aktivácii sa widgety zobrazia bez zás: Once activated, the widgets appear without any template changes. The product page gains:
hviezdičkové hodnotenie a počet recenzií: a star rating and review count right next to the product name,
sekcia Recenzie a hodnotenia s priemerom: a Reviews and ratings section with the average and the 1–5 star breakdown,
tlačidlo Napísať recenziu s formulárom —: a Write a review button with a form — rating, title, text, pros and cons,
možnosť pripojiť fotografie (JPG, JPEG,: the option to attach photos (JPG, JPEG, PNG, GIF, WEBP up to 10 MB) or a video.
Ktoré widgety sa zobrazujú, spravujete v: You manage which widgets are shown in the Widgets section of the Rewora admin.
V administrácii Rewora otvorte Recenzie: In the Rewora admin open Reviews → Reviews and click the new review.
V detaile vidíte nadpis, hodnotenie, tex: The detail shows the title, rating, text, pros and cons, the author, the review source and the language.
Vpravo hore kliknite na Označiť ako schv: Click Mark as approved in the top right — the review appears in the store straight away. The Featured toggle lets you highlight it above the others.
Stav žiadostí o recenziu ku konkrétnej o: You find the status of review requests for a given order in the Orders section — it shows whether the short-term or long-term request has already been sent.
Widgety sa na e-shope zobrazia až po ove: The widgets only appear in the store once your e-mail is verified and the subscription is active. A new review goes public only after approval — until then you see it just in the Rewora admin.
Napíšte nám a prejdeme nastavenie doplnk: Write to us and we will go through the setup together — including review requests and translations into other languages.
